title: Smoothness is etale local on the source
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $\{h_i:U_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ a jointly surjective family (every point of $X$ is the image of a point of some $U_i$) of etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then $f$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] if and only if each composite $f\circ h_i$ is smooth. No separatedness, quasi-compactness or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed. In particular, if $h:U\to X$ is etale, then $f$ is smooth at $h(u)$ if and only if $f\circ h$ is smooth at $u$: smooth at a point means smooth on an open neighbourhood of that point.

source.place: Tag 036U, lemma-smooth-smooth-local-source; etale covers are smooth covers. The pointwise assertion follows by restricting to open smooth loci and using openness of etale maps (Tag 01UA).
